Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TXN.
Operating income reached $8.9 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $10.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Our gross margin expanded by 110 basis points to 44.8%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $10.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.19 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
